added: A square's forward and back can turn off Go back, for a forward only that reads "forward" and counts 4 beats, as in "forward again and swing".
A square's promenade has a Direction, counter-clockwise unless you set it to clockwise; only a clockwise promenade says which way it goes.

changed: Square taxonomy v1, amended before release: sq_forward_and_back takes goBack (default true; off, 4 beats) and sq_promenade takes direction (spinDirection, default counterclockwise, silenced in the display); a wrong-way promenade is direction clockwise, so variant no longer offers wrongWay.
